unit.why: A short narrative: the Besht sees at a distance, through the holy spirit, a palace whose purpose was to shelter a hasid from hailstones for one hour, and he laughs at it.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the heading 'מענין ארץ', which belongs to the next entry (יז).

stories.start_quote: וכבר שמענו בזמננו שפ״א שחק הבעש״ט
stories.summary_en: The Besht saw from afar, through the holy spirit, a palace that had been built for sixteen years and never finished; in one hour it sheltered a hasid from hailstones, and it collapsed as soon as he left. The Besht laughed at the sight.

tags.why: The Besht sees a distant event through the holy spirit.

quotes: ובשעה אחת ניצל חסיד אחד מאבני אלגביש
וכשיצא משם אותו החסיד נפל הבנין
tags.why: The hasid is miraculously saved, and the building collapses right after he leaves.

quotes: שבנאו ארמון ט״ז שנים ולא השלימוהו
tags.why: The hidden purpose of the long, unfinished building becomes clear afterwards.

missing_concepts: divine providence (hashgacha pratit): a long-term event exists only to serve one moment of rescue
the tsaddik's laughter as a response to seeing providence at work
